comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Starting gate-calibration analysis (plan-review, code-review, completion-verifier): mining activity since each gate's last calibration to assess friction (plan-review PASS->BLOCK flips on novel late findings; completion-verifier FAILs on operator-attested ACs the agent could satisfy; code-review BLOCK threshold appropriateness). Deliverable: calibration assessment + recommended threshold/posture adjustments preserving 4-pass separation of concerns.

comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Plan-review evidence (782 runs / 225 tickets post-recal 96f5f374a): 55% pass round 1, 18% need 4+ rounds; sticky tail = 60% of gate compute. 38 PASS->BLOCK flips: 22 remediation-induced, 16 sampling-miss; 32% verdict instability on byte-identical plans. Remediation non-convergent: 95% of edits spawn new findings (net +324 over 430 edit rounds, ~13 advisories/round). Thresholds look correct (blocks land on deliberately-promoted T8/G1G2/E4/G6); dominant mechanism = missing cross-round novelty/convergence floor (code-review already has one, e05c4b531; epic 7d43-49c5 designed the plan-review equivalent). Awaiting config-map, completion-verifier, and Gerrit agents.

comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Completion-verifier evidence (42 closes post-ADR-0043): only ONE operator-attested FAIL (5f39 AC3) and it was RIGHTLY failed (Jira admin creds genuinely operator-held); admissibility bar fine (aa5a/7226 accepted comment evidence first try). Dominant pain = contagion: one unattestable AC -> 2 unsigned force-closes (5f39 + epic bf50, 19/19 landed), already bug 02a3. Aggravators: epic ACs demanding 'children closed (signed)' defeat certifiable:false; FAILs ratchet piecemeal (3b4e, 2 rounds -> 2 extra CI cycles); 1 stale-checkout false positive (003d); FAIL verdicts persist nowhere (empty run_snapshots) = calibration blind spot. Codebase-verifiable FAIL precision ~83% (5/6 real).

comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Config-map evidence: rising novelty floor (t_novel=0.7, floor=0.4) is SHIPPED for both plan-review (recall+floor, remediation_mode) and code-review (region-gated) but INERT — novelty_drop_active + remediation_mode default False, rebar.toml sets neither; every re-review is full+un-floored. Plan-review: 11 blocking criteria @0.60-0.75, 25 advisory @0.95; 3 post-cal FP fixes (grounding 3p symbols, G1G2 carve-out, snapshot read) mean pre-07-09 corpus overstates E4/G1G2 FPs. Code-review: only 2 DET security criteria block; LLM criteria advisory-locked by ADR 0036 pending A/B gate on code-v2 cohort. Completion verifier: binary, prompt-level knobs only. No .rebar overlay; changes go to packaged registries + pinning tests. Awaiting Gerrit agent.
